newsitem.title: MALTA: Yields unchanged in 28, 91-day Malta bill issues.
newsitem.headline: Yields unchanged in 28, 91-day Malta bill issues.

text.p: VALLETTA Sept 20 Rtr - Yield rates were unchanged in two Malta treasury bill issues on Friday.
The Treasury issued Lm 4.4 million in 28-day treasury bills maturing on October 18, 1996. The average yield rate is 4.9961 percent per annum, the same as the previous 28-day issue of September 6.
The Treasury also issued Lm 1.69 million in 91- day bills maturing on December 20, 1996 at a weighted average yield rate of 4.9974 percent per annum, the same as the previous issue on September 6.
